company_description_html:
In September 1992, China Resources Group (CR Group) invested Winland Investment Limited, a listed company in Hong Kong, and renamed it as “China Resources Enterprise, Limited (CR Enterprise)”. CR Enterprise was among the first Chinese enterprises to be listed in Hong Kong. As the first listed company of CR Group, CR Enterprise initiated a new era of Chinese companies entering international capital market. Through M&A, joint ventures, spin-offs IPO, asset replacement, CR Enterprise has facilitated CR Group on industrial transformation to drive faster business growth.

Since its establishment nearly 30 years ago, CR Enterprise has successively involved in mergers and acquisitions in 15 industries such as beer, real estate, consumer goods, retail, gas, and cement. CR Enterprise incubated and span off 4 listed companies for CR Group, including CR Land, CR Gas, CR Cement and CR Beer, maintaining its sound and professional image in the capital market.

Since 2010, CR Enterprise has been greatly focusing on consumption sector and diversifying its businesses in various industries. CR Enterprise has cultivated and incubated Snow Beer, C'estbon Beverage, CR Ng Fung, and CR Vanguard, which are household brands in the country. CR Enterprise currently owns businesses such as CR Logistics, Pacific Coffee, CRE Property, CRE Smartech and other businesses.Under China Resources Research Institute of Science and Technology, to promote the transformation of advanced research achievements at home and abroad.

CR Enterprise is the backbone of Hong Kong business development, the pioneer of overseas expansion and the accelerator to incubate new industries for CR Group.

During the 14th Five-Year Plan, CR Enterprise will closely focus on "321" business strategy. We will develop and expand 3 existing businesses of Logistic and Warehousing, Commercial Property and coffee, incubate and cultivate 2 new industries of plant-based protein and senior care services, speed up innovation and technology business, supporting Hong Kong to develop itself into an innovation and technology hub.

highlights: Location: near Kowloon Tong MTR station
description_html:
Established in 2009, Hong Kong Green Building Council (“the Council”) is the leading body, co-founded by four major construction industry and environmental organisations, driving the market transformation towards green and sustainable buildings in Hong Kong through engagement with the industry, the government and broader community.

HKGBC is expanding its secretariat team in line with its positioning as Hong Kong's leading member-based body dedicated to green building development, with opening for the post of Senior Executive – IT:

Job Description

  • Provide day-to-day end-user and application support (hardware, software, Microsoft 365, Zoom)
  • Support to incidents, service requests and solution implementation
  • Maintain and troubleshoots PC hardware and software, also inventory and regular reports update
  • Assist with network and telecommunication support (LAN/WAN, Wi-Fi, switches, basic firewall, AD, IP phones)
  • Communicate with service providers to ensure the smooth operation and efficiency of the IT systems
  • Coordinate with vendors, suppliers and internal users on IT and related procurement and project implementation
  • Perform any other IT related works and projects as assigned by supervisor

Requirements:

  • Degree or above in Technology, Computer Science or related disciplines
  • 1 year or above of solid IT support experience
  • Knowledgeable in Windows, Network Infrastructure, Security and Email technology
  • Strong technical troubleshooting skills and problem-solving abilities with hardware, software and network issues
  • Familiarity with web programming language will be an advantage
  • Familiarity with cloud infrastructure will be an advantage
  • Good command in English, Cantonese and Mandarin
  • Good interpersonal and communications skills
  • Willing to learn new knowledge and accept changes
  • Strong sense of integrity and conﬁdentiality

How to Apply

The Council is an equal opportunity employer and offers attractive career prospects and remuneration to our staff. Recruitment will be initially under contract terms of two years. Interested applicants please apply by sending full resume with date of availability, present and expected salary, contact telephone number, as well as results of public examinations to the Executive Director, Hong Kong Green Building Council via e-mail [via CTgoodjobs #Apply-Now-Email#], or by post to 1/F, Jockey Club Environmental Building, 77 Tat Chee Avenue, Kowloon Tong, Hong Kong. Please state the position you want to apply for on the envelope.

(N.B. Application with incomplete information as requested above may not be considered.)

Applicants who do not receive a response within six weeks from the date of this advertisement may consider their applications filed for future reference. Personal data will be used strictly for recruitment related purposes only and retained for no more than six months.

description_html:
Job Responsibilities:

  • Perform management and maintenance tasks for various databases.

  • Design, implement, and maintain High Availability (HA) / Disaster Recovery (DR) architectures for database environments.

  • Monitor databases and manage performance and capacity.

  • Troubleshoot database incidents and conduct root cause analysis.

  • Implement and maintain baseline configurations and security settings for databases.

  • Develop database-related policies, standards, procedures, and manuals.

  • Participate in the bank's domestic database transformation initiatives.

  • Contribute to the planning and implementation of daily database projects within the bank.

  • Track the latest database technologies and provide optimization recommendations.

  • Perform other assigned ad-hoc duties.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree or higher; Oracle OCP or higher-level certification preferred.

  • Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience in maintaining at least one of the following: Oracle, MySQL, SQL Server, including daily operations, troubleshooting, and performance tuning. Experience with domestic databases like GaussDB, PolarDB, or OceanBase is a plus.

  • Proficient in basic maintenance commands for Linux, Windows operating systems, and SAN storage.

  • Meticulous, responsible, and able to adhere to bank policies and regulations.

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills in both Chinese (Mandarin) and English; Cantonese speaking ability is advantageous.

  • Excellent analytical thinking and communication skills.

  • Ability to work independently and effectively under pressure.

 

Interested parties, please click #Apply-Now# for application.

Personal data collected will be used for recruitment purpose only.
company_description_html: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China (Asia) Limited (“ICBC (Asia)”) is the flagship of overseas business of Industrial and Commercial Bank of China Limited (“ICBC”) – currently the largest commercial bank in China, and it is one of the domestic systemically important banks (D-SIBs) in Hong Kong. Currently, ICBC (Asia) has 52 retail outlets (including 27 “Elite Club” Wealth Management Centres) in Hong Kong. It is engaged in commercial banking, investment banking and other financial services, including those of securities, insurance and funds, with a focus on commercial and retail banking as well as global market business. Chinese Mercantile Bank and ICBC Asset Management (Global) Company Limited, two wholly-owned subsidiaries of ICBC (Asia), specialize in Renminbi services in mainland China and ICBC’s global asset management business respectively.
